components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The one available next action in Goal Focus or a committed form footer.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid var(--blue); border-radius: 5px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; color: #fff; background: var(--blue); font: 700 13px/1.5 var(--font); cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s ease, border-color .16s ease; } .ds-primary-action svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-primary-action:hover { border-color: var(--blue-dark); background: var(--blue-dark); } .ds-primary-action:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue), transparent 28%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Goal Search
components.description: The single Navigator search field; it composes with status filtering without resetting Tree state.
components.html: <label class="ds-goal-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"></path></svg><input type="search" placeholder="在当前 Goal Tree 内搜索"><kbd>⌘F</kbd></label>
components.css: .ds-goal-search { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; color: var(--muted); font: 13px/1.5 var(--font); } .ds-goal-search > svg { position: absolute; left: 9px; width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-goal-search input { width: 100%; height: 30px; padding: 0 42px 0 29px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); font: inherit; } .ds-goal-search kbd { position: absolute; right: 7px; padding: 0 4px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--faint); background: var(--paper); font: 10px/17px var(--font); } .ds-goal-search input:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong); } .ds-goal-search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue), transparent 28%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Goal Tree Node
components.description: The current Goal path in Navigator: soft mineral wash, strong text, and one inset edge.
components.html: 建立克制一致的视觉系统gbui-visual-foundation执行中
components.css: .ds-tree-node { min-height: 31px; padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 5px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; color: var(--blue-dark); background: var(--blue-soft); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--blue); font: 12px/1.35 var(--font); text-decoration: none; } .ds-tree-node > span { min-width: 0; display: grid; } .ds-tree-node strong, .ds-tree-node small { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tree-node strong { font-weight: 620; } .ds-tree-node small { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue-dark), var(--muted) 45%); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .025em; } .ds-tree-node em { min-height: 19px; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 8%, transparent); font-size: 10px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tree-node svg { width: 11px; height: 11px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-tree-node:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue-soft) 82%, var(--paper)); } .ds-tree-node:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue), transparent 28%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Goal Detail Tabs
components.description: The five stable task panels inside Goal Focus, with one active panel and conventional keyboard semantics.
components.html: <nav class="ds-goal-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Goal 详情"><button role="tab" aria-selected="true">概览</button><button role="tab" aria-selected="false">完成要求</button><button role="tab" aria-selected="false">进展与阻塞</button><button role="tab" aria-selected="false">关联与约束</button><button role="tab" aria-selected="false">完整记录</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-goal-tabs { min-width: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; align-items: stretch; overflow-x: auto; background: var(--paper); font: 600 12px/1.5 var(--font); } .ds-goal-tabs button { position: relative; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 11px; border: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--muted); background: transparent; font: inherit; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-goal-tabs button::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 11px; right: 11px; bottom: -1px; height: 1px; background: transparent; } .ds-goal-tabs button:hover { color: var(--ink); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue-soft) 42%, transparent); } .ds-goal-tabs button[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--blue-dark); } .ds-goal-tabs button[aria-selected="true"]::after { background: var(--blue); } .ds-goal-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue), transparent 28%); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Goal Status Tag
components.description: A compact icon-and-word state; the color reinforces meaning but never replaces the label.
components.css: .ds-goal-status { min-height: 19px; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; color: var(--blue-dark); background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 8%, transparent); font: 650 10px/1.5 var(--font); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-goal-status svg { width: 11px; height: 11px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Theme Picker
components.description: Local Light, Dark, and System presentation preference with an explicit selected state.
components.css: .ds-theme-menu { width: 166px; padding: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 8px; display: grid; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); box-shadow: var(--shadow); font: 600 12px/1.5 var(--font); } .ds-theme-menu button { width: 100%; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 15px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--muted); background: transparent; font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-theme-menu button svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-theme-menu button:hover { color: var(--ink); background: var(--rail); } .ds-theme-menu button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--blue-dark); background: var(--blue-soft); } .ds-theme-menu button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue), transparent 28%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Decision Record
components.description: A continuous user-owned decision record ordered by question, timing, evidence, and consequences rather than dashboard metrics.
components.html:
需要你决定Candidate

要把这个候选 Goal 加入 Goal Tree 吗？

现在决定，是因为它会改变当前 Goal 的范围与后续验收。

建议
先确认它能否独立交付；证据不足时明确保留判断。
选择后
加入后成为新的权威 Goal；暂不加入则保留现有结构。
components.css: .ds-decision-record { border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 5px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); font: 13px/1.5 var(--font); } .ds-decision-record > header { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 13px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; color: var(--blue-dark); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 86%, var(--rail)); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 750; } .ds-decision-record > header small { color: var(--muted); } .ds-decision-record > div { padding: 12px 14px; } .ds-decision-record h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-decision-record p { margin: 4px 0 12px; color: var(--muted); } .ds-decision-record dl { margin: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-decision-record dl div { padding: 9px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 78px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 12px; } .ds-decision-record dt { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-decision-record dd { margin: 0; } .ds-decision-record footer { padding: 10px 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; } .ds-decision-record footer button { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 5px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); font: 650 12px/1.5 var(--font); cursor: pointer; } .ds-decision-record footer .ds-decision-primary { color: #fff; border-color: var(--blue); background: var(--blue); } .ds-decision-record footer button:hover { border-color: var(--blue); } .ds-decision-record footer .ds-decision-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-dark); } .ds-decision-record button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue), transparent 28%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Goal-bound Runtime Dock
components.description: A dark execution viewport whose chrome continuously names the Goal that owns the terminal.
components.html:
当前终端归属建立克制一致的视觉系统执行中
还没有终端添加终端后，在这个 Goal 上打开常用 Runtime。
components.css: .ds-runtime { padding: 9px 10px 10px; display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto auto minmax(260px, 1fr); gap: 7px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--rail); font: 13px/1.5 var(--font); } .ds-runtime > header { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 2px 8px; color: var(--muted); } .ds-runtime > header span { grid-column: 1 / -1; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-runtime > header strong { color: var(--ink); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-runtime > header em { color: var(--blue-dark); font-style: normal; font-weight: 650; } .ds-runtime nav { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-runtime nav button { min-height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 5px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); font: 600 12px/1.5 var(--font); cursor: pointer; } .ds-runtime nav button:hover { color: var(--blue-dark); background: var(--blue-soft); } .ds-runtime-terminal { min-height: 260px; border: 1px solid #2e3440; border-radius: 7px; display: grid; place-content: center; justify-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--terminal-ink); background: var(--terminal); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.025); text-align: center; } .ds-runtime-terminal svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 5px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); } .ds-runtime-terminal span { max-width: 34ch; color: #89919f; } .ds-runtime button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue), transparent 28%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Mobile Surface Switch
components.description: The narrow companion's exclusive Goals, Focus, and Runtime navigation.
components.html: <nav class="ds-mobile-switch" role="tablist" aria-label="移动端视图"><button role="tab" aria-selected="true">目标</button><button role="tab" aria-selected="false">当前</button><button role="tab" aria-selected="false">运行</button></nav>

narrative.overview:
GoalBoard should feel like a quiet place where intent stays legible while work moves between people and AI Runtimes. It is the cross-Runtime truth source for long-running Goals, not a Dashboard and not an Agent Orchestration console. The selected Goal is the continuous thread: users locate it in Navigator, understand and decide in Focus, then act through its Goal-bound Runtime without losing ownership or context.

The world combines graphite and cool-paper materials, one mineral-blue current path, dense native system type, Lucide line icons, one-pixel seams, restrained 4–8px corners, and a dark terminal well. Wide workstation and narrow Harness-companion layouts are two responsive expressions of the same world. Light, Dark, and Follow System are first-class presentation preferences and do not change domain truth.

This document carbonizes the shipped visual foundation, Navigator, action-led Focus, responsive Runtime workbench, and the read-only Goal Graph. The approved promotional workstation screenshots remain separate acceptance artifacts; they must not be mistaken for permission to replace real GoalBoard behavior with a decorative mock.
keyCharacteristics: One selected Goal remains continuous across Navigator, Focus, and Runtime.
A quiet 48px app bar sits above a seam-built three-pane workstation.
Cool rail, paper, and graphite surfaces create hierarchy without dashboard cards.
Mineral blue marks current path and available action; semantic colors remain sparse.
Native system typography and Lucide line icons keep the interface compact and familiar.
Light, Dark, and System themes preserve identical structure and meaning.
Narrow layouts expose Goals, Focus, and Runtime one at a time through an underline switch.
Cursor-driven refresh preserves selection, reading position, open controls, and in-progress input.

rules.name: The Mineral Path Rule
rules.body: Mineral blue marks the selected path and an available action; it does not flood whole work surfaces.

rules.name: The Semantic Pairing Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, violet, and red always travel with readable text and, where helpful, a Lucide icon; color is never the only status carrier.

rules.name: The Theme Parity Rule
rules.body: Light, Dark, and Follow System change presentation only. They preserve hierarchy, component state, focus visibility, and Goal meaning.

rules.name: The Native Tool Rule
rules.body: Do not add a brand font merely to make GoalBoard look designed; precision, density, and hierarchy carry the identity.

rules.name: The Human-First Reading Rule
rules.body: Keep Outcome, Why, business logic, decisions, and failure explanations as readable sentences; protocol nouns and opaque IDs are supporting metadata.

rules.name: The Selected Goal Thread Rule
rules.body: Selecting a Goal changes Focus while preserving the Goal-owned Runtime relationship; Navigator, Focus, and Runtime always name the same context explicitly when they offer an action.

rules.name: The Stable Workspace Rule
rules.body: Cursor-driven refresh atomically replaces authoritative Goal content while preserving selection, collapsed branches, filters, scroll, mobile surface, resizer widths, disclosures, URL history, and valid in-progress form state. Focused live forms defer background replacement; a successful submission forces one authoritative refresh without a white frame.

rules.name: The Single Decision Door Rule
rules.body: `/decisions` is the only full user-decision surface. Goal detail may show a count and deep link, but it never duplicates the complete decision form or implies that a Runtime can approve its own proposal.

rules.name: The Seam-First Rule
rules.body: Use tonal layering and 1px seams for persistent structure; reserve shadow for a temporary surface that truly overlaps the workspace.

rules.name: The Small-Radius Rule
rules.body: Ordinary interface geometry stays within the shipped 4–8px range; larger radii require a new, explicit product reason.

dos: Do keep the selected Goal explicit across Navigator, Focus, and Runtime.
Do preserve Goal Tree selection, collapsed branches, filters, scroll, mobile surface, resizer widths, disclosures, and valid form input across live refresh.
Do keep the five Goal Detail tabs stable, keyboard operable, single-panel, and deep-link aware.
Do keep `/decisions` as the sole full decision surface and lead each decision with the user's question, timing, evidence, and consequences.
Do keep Runtime tabs bound to their owner Goal and route non-executable parents to concrete child Goals.
Do pair every semantic color with readable state text and, where useful, one Lucide icon.
Do use the same semantic hierarchy and behavior in Light, Dark, and Follow System.
Do let the document-container rule stack complex fields at 660px and the shell switch surfaces at 760px.
Do use 1px seams, opaque tonal surfaces, compact system type, and restrained 4–8px corners.
Do keep pending and recent decision outcomes grounded in canonical events, Evidence, and user reasons.
donts: Don't turn GoalBoard into a Dashboard, Kanban, or Agent Orchestration control room.
Don't fragment continuous Goal truth into a grid of decorative cards.
Don't use gradients, glass surfaces, decorative glow, heavy persistent shadows, or oversized radii.
Don't use mineral blue as ambient decoration; reserve it for current path, focus, links, and available action.
Don't use color alone for Ready, Blocked, Risk, Review, connection, or completion state.
Don't mix icon families, emoji, or unlabeled glyphs into the Lucide line language.
Don't duplicate full decisions inside Goal detail or expose internal protocol nouns as the only explanation.
Don't rebind, reopen, write to, or close a Runtime terminal from the wrong Goal or an execution-ineligible parent.
Don't show Goals, Focus, and Runtime simultaneously below 760px.
Don't treat the approved workstation screenshots as global page templates or replace the shipped Navigator, Focus, Graph, or Runtime behaviors with decorative mock content.
